summary: AXIA Energia S.A. (formerly Eletrobras) filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, announcing its intention to voluntarily delist all common and class C preferred American Depositary Shares (ADSs) from the NYSE and withdraw registration under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act. No price or premium is stated; the delisting is non-transactional. The company's shares will remain listed on B3 (Brazil), its primary venue. ADSs are expected to continue trading OTC via a Level 1 sponsored program with Citibank. No shareholder action is required. Watch for the filing of Form 25 and any SEC or NYSE procedural delays.
